quotes.quote: I had a teammate, Chucky Atkins, in Denver. He really, I had confidence, but like, he gave me a whole another level of confidence as a person who liked to dance on the court. So if you just take the three, what is the game in college becoming? And I agree, I agree that the 35-second shot clock is long. Or foul, or play fast, right? Go get offensive rebounds, but I need a three or a layup. That's a tough way to teach the game, because these guys don't even know how to do that yet in college.
